title: PRESIDENT’S GREETINGS ON THE OCCASION OF  CHHATH PUJA
body_text: The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu sends greetings to fellow citizens on Chhath Puja. In her message, the President has said, “On the auspicious occasion of Chhath, the festival of faith and Sun worship, I extend my heartfelt greetings and best wishes to all Indians living in India and abroad. This festival symbolises deep reverence for Surya Dev and Chhathi Maiya. Celebrated over four days, it highlights the importance of our cultural traditions through devotion, discipline and dedication. During Chhath Puja devotees offer ‘Arghya’ to Surya Dev praying for happiness, prosperity and the well-being of their families. The festival inspires us to express gratitude to nature and to preserve the environment. May this sacred festival bring joy and peace to all, and promote love and harmony in the society. On this occasion, let us pledge to fulfil our responsibility to protect and conserve rivers and other water bodies”. **** MJPS/SS/PRK
